segments.summary: Reviewed all 186 core lines from OSI-430 through the closing FABLE audit-lineage marker. Exact contracts centralize DRY ownership and event-backed coordination, reject JSON-mirror authority, define optimistic concurrency and conflict recovery, and bound several adjacent orchestration behaviors. Adversarial review found missing shared-bundle failure semantics, receipt oracles, seglog-to-projection crash recovery, path-hash identity rules, saturation behavior, debug-mirror privacy lifecycle, executable permission-denied liveness verification, and continuity redaction lifecycle semantics.
